relevance_note: Case report of one boy with a TNFAIP3 variant: "a novel de novo heterozygous 2 bp deletion in tumour necrosis factor-alpha-induced protein 3 (TNFAIP3".
method_note: Written by hand with a small Python script assembling the rows; no table transcribed by script. One in-scope person, labelled 'patient' (rule 5; the figure's '(P)' is a role abbreviation versus controls). Parents ('healthy non-consanguineous British parents') and siblings ('healthy unaffected siblings', a first-born infant who died of prematurity, figure 1A legend) get no rows: not described as tested or affected. The paper calls the variant 'de novo' but does not describe parental testing, so inheritance and parental_testing_statement are 'not reported' (rule 8 / D-24). The cDNA is printed in two forms: 'c.1466_1467delTG' (text) and 'c.1466_1467TGdel' (figure 1 legend); protein 'p.V489Afs*7' (text) and 'V489Afs*7' (legend). The text forms are recorded. Age 14 is the age when investigated; the latest follow-up (21 months post-transplant) gives no age, so age_at_last_evaluation '14-year-old' may predate the last evaluation. Table 1 lab values below the reference range (haemoglobin 9.8, platelets 29, low pneumococcal antibodies, FEV1 38%) were not turned into separate features beyond those the text names (cytopaenias, lymphopaenia). Checklist: 'hepatitis' and 'cytopaenias' marked autoimmune because the text lists them under 'complex autoimmunity'; 'enteropathy' marked as gastrointestinal inflammation. 'No other autoantibodies were detected' is recorded as an excluded feature; it does not change the autoantibody checklist item, which is observed (anti-GAD, islet cell antibody, pANCA). No contradictions found.

Twenty-one months post-transplant, he is thriving off all immunosuppressive medication with complete remission of autoimmune disease (except diabetes)
*Peripheral neutrophils were supported pretransplant by recombinant granulocyte colony stimulating factor
Post-HSCT antibody indices were measured during concomitant subcutaneous immunoglobulin supplementation

clinical_diagnosis_basis.value: Genetic: whole exome sequencing identified a heterozygous TNFAIP3 2 bp deletion, confirmed by capillary sequencing, with functional validation in fibroblasts; STAT3 and FOXP3 variants excluded
span: By whole exome sequencing of peripheral blood genomic DNA (Illumina MiSeq) and downstream bioinformatic filtering (Ingenuity Variant Analysis), we identified a single biologically plausible variant
which we confirmed by capillary sequencing10 (figure 1B)
Pathogenic variants in STAT3 and FOXP3 were excluded.

functional_evidence_statement.value: Reduced basal and TNF-α-induced A20 protein in patient fibroblasts (immunoblot); exaggerated and prolonged phosphorylation of NF-κB pathway components after TNF-α; increased range and magnitude of TNF-α-stimulated differential gene expression (RNA-seq); enhanced IL-6 protein by ELISA (p=0.0015)
span: Immunoblotting10 of patient and control dermal fibroblast lysates with an N-terminal antibody confirmed the reduced basal and TNF-α-induced expression of A20 (figure 1D)
We observed exaggerated and prolonged phosphorylation of components of the NF-κB pathway
RNA sequencing (Illumina NextSeq-500) revealed a significant global increase in both the range and magnitude of TNF-α-stimulated differential gene expression
We also confirmed enhanced expression of the key NF-κB target gene interleukin 6 (IL-6) at the protein level by ELISA (p=0.0015, figure 1G)
Early-onset autoimmune disease due to a heterozygous loss-of-function mutation in TNFAIP3 (A20)
a novel de novo heterozygous 2 bp deletion
